OAT-01/S10.detail: Seconds from sessions:_revokeForEmail to 'Send sign-in code' on an open chart, 10 runs per case, fresh account signed in through the form: no interaction median 1.24 s, worst 3.40 s (all 10 cleared without input: the session row is in every query's read set, so the open subscriptions re-run and refuse at once); one tap median 1.21 s, worst 2.23 s; tab switch median 0.63 s, worst 5.75 s (visibilitychange hidden->visible dispatched in the page: headless tabs never go hidden). No run kept the chart on screen. No target exists (Q7); e-mail arrival seconds (Q12) are S01's and need a real mailbox, not measured here. 8 of the first 30 runs failed in SETUP under load (sign-in 500 / response timeout) and were re-run. Manual gap: e-mail arrival seconds (Q12) need a real mailbox.
